objective: BUKLOD Empire Arena premium native gameplay HUD, readable Genesis map graphics and 13 canon-identity actor visual feedback with customizable, ergonomically arranged round touch controls, bounded zoom, safe scene layout and per-device controller preferences. Offline staging practice only. Add a fully playable, best-of-three, disconnected solo duel against real local CPU opponents selectable from the 13 canonical heroes, with difficulty, round scoring, equivalent level-6 match-only abilities and no ranked/reward impact. Sound and graphics completeness: real event-to-audio mappings for ally/enemy hero kills, tower/seal/building damage, farming by material, buff wildlife, inventory pickup/use, construction completion and upgrades; implement 2.5D state-driven resource/loot/buff/structure graphics while verifying all local hero poses and scene art. Action-specific weapon slashes, real victim hit reaction, hero death/KO animation, themed arena terrains/citadels and optional offline-device announcer with focus, mute and priority controls.

selectionRationale: Owner-provided landscape screenshots show overlap, clipped controls, oversized models and poor battlefield readability; the existing in-app 13-character assets and local scene plates can support a high-fidelity native HUD without a new engine, independent app or license risk. Scoped overlays and normalized editor improve usability while preserving canonical economy authority. Existing practice CPU trains/mines and does not deliver a direct no-signal fight; an isolated local hero duel reuses the same authoritative per-match combat engine rather than creating a fake animation-only demo. Existing event router reduced dozens of meaningful Arena events to six generic SFX; this work introduces semantic, priority-scored audio keyed to engine-proven events and stronger source-owned world object art. Original voice engine uses already installed expo-speech as an optional device-local announcer; no external voice API/new subscription or rank privilege.
alternativeApproaches: Use ready-made Mobile Legends interface textures or clone their HUD (rejected: visual IP concerns and no BUKLOD identity).
Replace Arena engine with a new standalone 3D game/Unity/Godot app (rejected: heavy native builds, extra cost and breaks single BUKLOD app contract).
Reimport unverified third-party Library sound and sprite ZIPs wholesale (rejected: mixed asset licenses and unbounded mobile bundle growth).
Keep original row of tiny box action buttons (rejected: unsatisfactory ergonomics, premium requirement not met).
